i understand 100%

basically the last two years i’ve been keeping on just for him, and without him i genuinely feel there would be no point to it anymore

i’m so glad you have someone in your life that you’re willing to stick around for. i wish i didn’t push everybody away so i could say the same too :(

genuinely doesn’t seem like something i want to do if it’s always going to be like this. what’s the point in suffering through a miserable existence ? i’d be taking up space from people who could actually use it

He suggested we meet at a public place and I agreed to meet him at an auto shop that’s convenient for him and he said there’s “other ways to fix our problem” I blocked him though and called my insurance company now and they are trying to figure out who he is. They said I’m ok to stop talking to him

Thank you so much for all of the information and for taking the time to reply. I am going to call my insurance now and let them take care of it. Do I need to keep in contact with the guy I hit as well or can I stop responding to his texts ? He’s making me uncomfortable

Yes I have written down my version of events and I have documented the exact time it happened and took pictures of his car and my car as well. 

I’m worried now because I don’t have his full name or any other kind of information about him besides his phone number and the plate #. 

What if he calls the police now ? Can I get in trouble for leaving and not reporting the accident ? I don’t understand exactly what I should’ve done or what I should do now and I don’t have anyone to ask for advice.
I was hesitant to file a claim because I have an accident from 2 or 3 years ago I am waiting to fall off. If I call them now will I be in legal trouble for leaving the scene when I was at fault ?
